name: painted-collage
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: a large hand-painted collage on canvas, PHOTOGRAPHED IN A STUDIO — the canvas edges are visible, with a bare wall and floor showing around it.
· PAINT: flat matte acrylic fields with visible brush drag and slightly wobbly hand-painted edges. No blending, no digital gradients.

· COLLAGE: hand-cut photographic fragments glued on — soft-focus, greyed, from old magazines. They sit at a different sharpness and colour temperature to the paint, with visible cut edges and small paper shadows.
· CLOTHING AND OBJECTS: painted as flat geometric pattern — checks, stripes, blocks — not as rendered fabric.
· PALETTE: muted and chalky — lavender, ochre, warm grey, brown, with one or two small saturated accents.
· LIGHT: even, flat gallery light. No dramatic shadows.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
